column1: # datasets.tsv — 16S V4 runs for the depth-invariance study
# Columns (tab-separated):  accession  label  biome  trunc_f  trunc_r
# CLAIM UNDER TEST
# Denoising cost scales with SEQUENCING DEPTH. Classification cost scales with
# COMMUNITY RICHNESS (ASV count), which saturates with depth. The two stages
# therefore need independently sized allocations, and sizing a classification
# job by read count -- current practice everywhere, including this repository's
# own SLURM templates before this study -- measures the wrong quantity.
# The controlled pair that tests this directly:
#   ERR3444605  naso-D003-ANS      66,993 reads -> 54 ASVs
#   ERR3444628  naso-D006-deep  1,804,054 reads -> 58 ASVs
# Same study, same body site, same protocol. 27x the sequencing depth yields 7%
# more ASVs. If classification cost tracked reads these two would differ 27-fold;
# if it tracks ASVs, they cost the same.
# The remaining rows give a modest richness spread (5-70 ASVs) at comparable
# depth, used for the cost-vs-ASV-count curve.
# COMPOSITION — single study, single protocol
# Every run is from ENA study PRJEB33591 / ERP116397, "Outer Ear and Nasopharynx
# as Sources of the Middle Ear Microbiome during Otitis Media with Effusion":
# Illumina MiSeq, PAIRED, 2x251 bp, 16S rRNA V4, Caporaso 515F/806R, submitted
# already primer-trimmed (measured median ASV length 253 bp).
# Drawing every sample from one study removes batch effects, extraction-protocol
# differences and primer-variant differences as confounders. Since the dependent
# variable here IS ASV count, anything that perturbs ASV inference for technical
# reasons contaminates the result directly.
# --- Middle ear / ear canal: lowest richness -------------------------------
# --- Adenoid: highest richness in this set ---------------------------------
# --- Depth axis: same body site, ~27x the reads ----------------------------
# EXCLUDED — and why
# PRJDB3924 (DRR045560, DRR045575, DRR045578, DRR045563), rhizosphere soil.
# Downloaded and denoised; excluded after inspection, for two reasons.
# 1. Reads retain their PCR primers. Measured median merged ASV length was
#    292 bp = 253 (V4) + 19 (515F) + 20 (806R), and the ASV sequences begin
#    GTGCCAGCCGCCGCGGTAA / GTGCCAGCAGCCGCGGTAA -- both variants of the
#    degenerate M position in 515F. Variation at primer positions reflects the
#    primer pool, not the template, so DADA2 splits one organism across several
#    ASVs. That inflates exactly the quantity this study measures.
# 2. They were included to supply high richness and did not. At 54-60k reads
#    they yielded 90-105 ASVs, level with the adenoid samples above. Rhizosphere
#    soil would normally give 10^2-10^3. Whatever the cause, they add a second
#    study's batch effects without extending the richness range.
# PRJDB3826 ("validation of preparation for ampricon sequencing by MiSeq about
# soil samples") has an EMPTY library_construction_protocol field, so its primer
# region is undocumented. Never use undocumented runs here: a region mismatch is
# invisible except as quietly degraded classification.
